question: Which NFA variant has the highest iron content, and what capacity did it keep at 1C in the rate test?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%Fe0%' OR text ILIKE '%1C%' OR text ILIKE '%iron content%' OR text ILIKE '%x = %' OR text ILIKE '%mAh g%' ORDER BY page, id LIMIT 150

SELECT id, row_no, col_no, text FROM cells WHERE table_id='p5.T1' AND (row_no<=8) ORDER BY row_no, col_no
